root_cause: Cursor stores only created_at; orders sharing a timestamp at a page boundary are skipped (and a naive >= fix duplicates them). Secondary: next_cursor is emitted when the last page is exactly full, and malformed cursors with valid base64/JSON raise KeyError instead of ValueError.
expected_fix_points: Sort by a unique key such as (created_at, id)
Encode both fields in the cursor and compare tuples
Fetch limit + 1 rows to decide whether next_cursor exists
Normalise every cursor decoding failure to ValueError -> 400
twist_points: Direction parameter validated in service and API
Descending comparison uses < on the tuple
Cursor carries its direction; mismatch is rejected
